question: Who in Maya's interval and above needs no activity, independent all-round?
premises: no activity, thus indeed; independent he, all round
thereby in Maya-interval who are Rudras
inference: Maya-interval Rudras and beyond act not, independent all-round.
uncertainties: nirapeksha reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: No activity, thus indeed; independent he, all round — thereby in Maya-interval who are Rudras, and who above that.
